SELECT 'STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) TRAN_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE',COUNT(*),TRAN_DATE FROM EDS.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE GROUP BY TRAN_DATE
